items.title: OpenResty流模块UAF
items.summary_zh: 远程对端可在 receiveuntil 迭代器被回收时触发释放后重用，造成内存破坏。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至 stream-lua-nginx-module 0.0.20rc4
items.repro_note: 构造 receiveuntil 模式并触发迭代器回收竞争
items.impact_scope: OpenResty流模块，公网代理面
items.description: OpenResty stream-lua-nginx-module before 0.0.20rc4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows remote peers to trigger access to freed memory when a receiveuntil() pattern iterator is garbage-collected while still referenced by the socket. Attackers can interrupt or close the cosocket connection so later reads or socket closure use the stale pattern pointer, crashing or corrupting the nginx worker.

items.description: Nektos act 0.2.92 before 0.2.95 contains an argument injection vulnerability in readProjectArgsFile and projectFlag that allows malicious repositories to bypass the untrusted project .actrc flag allowlist. Attackers can commit a crafted .actrc smuggling disallowed flags like -P self-hosted or --privileged to run workflow steps on the developer's host.

items.title: CWE-73
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·免认证·需用户交互)
items.description: pain001-mcp 0.0.72 before 0.0.80 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the commit_payment_batch MCP tool that allows attackers to write files outside any output directory via output_file_path. Attackers can stage a batch, reuse the self-issued confirmation_token, and supply absolute, dot-dot, or symlinked paths to create or overwrite server-writable files with generated XML.
